caption: A balloon rubbed on a sweater is held over a bowl of sugar, and a fine dusting of sugar jumps up to the balloon.

sa.check: A balloon is rubbed on a sweater.
The balloon is held over the bowl.
A fine dusting of sugar jumps up to the balloon.
Only a fine dusting lifts; the bulk of the sugar stays in the bowl.
The rub comes first, then the hold, then the sugar jumps.

pc.expect: The sugar lies still until the balloon is close above it, then the finest grains leap up to the balloon; grains lift only beneath the balloon and stop when it is taken away.
pc.fail: Sugar leaps before the balloon is brought near; or grains lift from parts of the bowl far from the balloon; or the whole bowl of sugar stirs; or grains keep leaping after the balloon is well away.

pc.expect: The grains that lift cling to the balloon's underside; the bulk of the sugar stays in the bowl; any grain that lets go falls back into the bowl.
pc.fail: Grains hover in the air between bowl and balloon without touching either; or the whole heap rises out of the bowl; or a grain that lets go drifts upward or sideways; or grains climb past the balloon and continue up.

pc.expect: The balloon is a light elastic shell that keeps its round shape; the sugar is loose grains that lift as separate specks.
pc.fail: The balloon keeps a deep dent after the hand leaves; or stretches out like taffy; or the sugar lifts as a solid lump; or the sugar flows up like liquid.

pc.expect: Each grain moves straight up from the sugar's surface to the balloon and stops on it.
pc.fail: Grains fly past the balloon and off; or circle the balloon in the air; or bounce off and back several times; or grains move away from the balloon.

pc.expect: One balloon and one bowl; the grains on the balloon came from the bowl; the balloon passes through nothing.
pc.fail: Sugar multiplies on the balloon; or grains vanish in mid-air; or the balloon passes into the bowl; or the bowl's sugar level jumps or the bowl vanishes.

pc.expect: The balloon's colour, the bowl and the sugar's colour stay the same.
pc.fail: The balloon changes colour or size; or the bowl changes; or the sugar changes colour.
